title: Primitives Schema
description: Defines atomic primitives used throughout the Resonance Substrate Model (RSM), including numeric ranges, vectors, matrices, flags, and generic key-value structures. Serves as the foundational layer for all higher-level schemas.

number.description: A basic numeric primitive used across fields, operators, and configurations.

integer.description: A whole-number primitive for counts, indices, and discrete parameters.

boolean.description: A true/false primitive used for flags and toggles.

vector.description: A numeric vector of arbitrary dimension.

range.description: A numeric range with minimum and maximum bounds.

key_value.description: A generic key-value structure for flexible metadata or configuration.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for documentation, provenance, or schema evolution.
